Without type parameters, `createEventDispatcher()` lets a component dispatch any event with any detail, and its users get no types for them. The rule looks at components with a `<script lang="ts">` under Svelte 3 and 4, where the plugin finds them.

{/* Generated by src/codegen/lint-rule-docs.ts. Do not edit this section. */}

## Configure

Off by default. It runs on the Svelte components that an ESLint config lints with `svelte-eslint-parser`, in the place of the rule of `eslint-plugin-svelte`:

{/* skip */}

```js eslint.config.js
import svelte from "eslint-plugin-svelte";

export default [
  ...svelte.configs.recommended,
  { rules: { "svelte/require-event-dispatcher-types": "error" } },
];
```

{/* End of the generated section. */}

## Examples

Reported:

{/* bad {"packages": {"svelte": "4.2.19"}} */}

```svelte
<script lang="ts">
  import { createEventDispatcher } from "svelte";
  const dispatch = createEventDispatcher();
</script>
```

Not reported:

{/* good {"packages": {"svelte": "4.2.19"}} */}

```svelte
<script lang="ts">
  import { createEventDispatcher } from "svelte";
  const dispatch = createEventDispatcher<{ save: string }>();
</script>
```
